e.title: **一个**把**健康险理赔裁决**做成**三代理串行**、**再**用**确定性闸门**收口的**可观测系统****：`meridian-claims-observability`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**not a toy example**」**；**⭐ 三代理**逐字为**保单核验、病史查询、欺诈与例外**，**再**接**一个 deterministic decision gate****；**⭐ 工具**逐字**经 **MCP（stdio）** 调用**而**不是**直接函数调用**（**`check_coverage`／`lookup_medical_history`／`fraud_score`**）**；**⭐ 本地模型**逐字为 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`（6GB 显存）**，**回退**为 **OpenRouter 免费层****；**⭐ 评测**逐字**由真实 **Langfuse Dataset** 支撑**（**逐字**「**not a hardcoded fixture**」**）**；**⭐ 许可证**逐字为 **MIT**
e.title_en: A health-insurance claims-adjudication system built as three sequential agents closed by a deterministic gate, and instrumented end to end: it states in writing that it is not a toy example, runs policy verification, medical history, and fraud-and-exception agents behind a deterministic decision gate, has its agents call tools through a standard protocol server rather than direct function calls, uses a local seven-billion-parameter model on a six-gigabyte card with a free hosted fallback, backs its evaluation dashboard with a real observability dataset rather than a hardcoded fixture, and carries an MIT licence.

e.summary_en: This is a health-insurance claims-adjudication demonstration system built from three sequential agents, describing itself in writing as a real, running claims-adjudication system and explicitly as not a toy example. **Measured this round**: two stars, two forks, created on the fourth of September and last pushed on the sixth, a repository of roughly three megabytes, an MIT licence, and fourteen topic tags; **its documentation site returned two hundred with about fifteen kilobytes, and its description runs to ten kilobytes over one hundred seventy-four lines**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.** **Four things are worth reading: the language-model agents are closed by a deterministic decision gate, which is what makes the division between a model that proposes and a rule that decides auditable in claims work; tools are reached through a standard protocol server rather than by direct function calls, so the tool layer is decoupled from the orchestration framework; the evaluation dashboard is backed by a real observability dataset rather than a hardcoded fixture, and the project records a genuine incident in which a seed-data gap let a claim route incorrectly and was caught and fixed through evaluation; and the whole stack is meant to run on modest hardware, with a local seven-billion-parameter model on a six-gigabyte card, a free hosted fallback, and an explicit note that no container runtime is required.** **The system was not deployed or run this round, and its login gate is described as being for demonstration only rather than as a real authentication boundary.**
e.body:
**Meridian Claims**（`ashishpatel26/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo`）**是一个**健康险理赔裁决的**多代理演示系统****——**逐字自述为**「**A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system**」**，**并**逐字声明**「**not a toy example**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三代理之后**接**确定性闸门****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**工作流**为**保单核验（**`check_coverage`**）→ 病史查询（**`lookup_medical_history`**）→ 欺诈与例外（**`fraud_score`**）→ 决策闸门（**逐字 **deterministic**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**理赔**这类**有**金钱后果**的**流程**里**，**「**谁做决定**」**必须**能**在**事后**指认**——**⭐ 若**决定**由**模型**给出**，**则**审计**只能**复现**一次**概率**；**⭐ 若**决定**由**规则**给出**，**而**模型**只**提供**输入**与**理由**，**则**每一次**拒绝或**赔付**都**可以**被**逐条**解释**；**⭐ 这是**把**AI 放进**受监管流程**的**第一步**分工**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 工具层**经过 **MCP**，**而**不是**直接调用****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**a local MCP server (stdio) serving `check_coverage`, `lookup_medical_history`, `fraud_score`**」**，**并逐字注明**「**agents call tools through CrewAI MCP adapter, not direct function calls**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**对 RIAA **尤其有用**：**⭐ 即**工具**与**编排框架**解耦**之后**，**同一套**工具**可以**换**框架**（**逐字提到的 **CrewAI** 只是**当前选择**）**，**而**工具**本身**可以**被**单独**测试**与**替换**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 评测**有真实数据集**，**并**记录了**一次真实事故****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写明**评测仪表盘**「**shows decision-routing pass/fail per seeded claim, backed by a real Langfuse Dataset — not a hardcoded fixture**」**；**⭐ 并逐字写道**：**开发期**「**A real failure was caught and fixed this way during development (a seed-data gap that let a claim route incorrectly)**」**，**细节**见其**演示脚本文件**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一条**是**本轮**最值得**别的项目**学的**：**⭐ 即**把**「**评测抓到过什么**」**写进**文档**，**比**把**「**我们很重视评测**」**写进**文档**有用**得多**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 全链路可观测的工具选择****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**逐字技术栈**为**后端 **Python 3.12（`uv`）**、**CrewAI（顺序流程）**、**FastAPI、**SQLite****；**可观测**逐字为**Langfuse Cloud**，**含**追踪、**会话（**每笔理赔一个**）**、**用户（**按患者标注**）**、**数据集与**数据集运行**与**评分**，**并**另有**一个**由应用自管的 **LLM 裁判**做**持续的**有据性打分**；**⭐ README 逐字说明**分工**：**SQLite 是**应用自己的**运营存储**，**Langfuse 是**可观测与评测的**记录系统**，**界面里**每一个**查看追踪**的链接**都**指回**它**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 跑起来**的门槛**写得**很低****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**逐字写明**本地 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`** 跑在 **6GB 显存** 的 **GPU** 上**，**回退**为 **OpenRouter 免费层**；**逐字注明**「**No Docker/Podman required**」**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**登录闸门**为 **`admin`**／**`admin`**、**且**「**demo-only, not a real auth boundary**」**——**⭐ 本词条**如实转述**这一句**：**⭐ 即**作者**自己**标注了**它**不是**安全边界**，**而**这**正好**是**学生**做**演示系统**时**应当**有的**自觉**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claims-integrity-investigator]] 覆盖**理赔侧的**确定性与**欺诈指标审查**、**[[azure-medical-claims-processing]] 覆盖**云厂商的**医疗理赔参考实现**、**[[insurance-fraud-frozen-demo]] 覆盖**车险欺诈的**演示空间**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**多代理 + **MCP 工具层** + **确定性闸门** + **真实评测数据集**」**这一**组合**，**并且**把**本地小模型**的**可行性**写成了**前提**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **模型提意见**、**规则做决定**；**② **工具**放**协议层**（**MCP**）**，**不**写死在**框架里**；**③ **评测集**要**是**真的**数据集**，**而**不是**代码里的**硬编码样本**；**④ **把**评测抓到的事故**写进**文档**；**⑤ **演示系统**的**认证**要**自己**标注**不是**安全边界**；**⑥ **在**6GB 显存**与**免费层**上**把**整条链**跑通**，**是**可复现的**最低标准**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有部署、**没有运行**该系统**（**未跑 **`uv run`** 任何命令**、**未起**前后端、**未调用**任何模型或可观测服务**）**，**故**不主张**其**裁决逻辑**的**正确性**、**也**不主张**其**评测结果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 文本**、**仓库树条目**与**文档站点响应**，**未读**其**源代码**与 **`PRD.md`** 内容**。**③ ⚠️ 其自述**「**real, running**」**与**「**not a toy example**」**均为**作者**表述**，**⚠️ 本词条**如实转述**，**未**独立验证**其**在**真实业务规模**下的**表现**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**工具返回的**病患与**保单数据**是**模拟数据**（**⭐ README 逐字提到 **`mcp_server.py`** 内含 **mock data**，**故**本条**按**模拟数据**理解**，**并**标注为**依据自述**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**健康险公司**的关系**；**⚠️ 并如实指出**：**本项目**名称**含 **CNCF**，**但**本条**只**按**仓库自述**记录**，**未**主张**其**为**任何基金会的**正式项目**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该系统**是**工程演示**，**不是**理赔决定**，**也**不是**合规意见**。

e.body_hk:
**Meridian Claims**（`ashishpatel26/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo`）**是一個**健康險理賠裁決的**多代理演示系統****——**逐字自述為**「**A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system**」**，**並**逐字聲明**「**not a toy example**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三代理之後**接**確定性閘門****——**工作流逐字為**保單核驗（**`check_coverage`**）→ 病史查詢（**`lookup_medical_history`**）→ 欺詐與例外（**`fraud_score`**）→ 決策閘門（**逐字 deterministic**）**；**⭐ 即**在理賠這類**有金錢後果的流程裡**，**「**誰做決定**」**必須**事後可指認**——**決定由規則給出**、**模型只提供輸入與理由**，**每次拒絕或賠付才可被逐條解釋**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 工具層經過 MCP，**而**不是直接調用****——**逐字**「**a local MCP server (stdio) serving `check_coverage`, `lookup_medical_history`, `fraud_score`**」**，**並逐字註明**「**agents call tools through CrewAI MCP adapter, not direct function calls**」**；**⭐ 即**工具與編排框架解耦**，**同一套工具可換框架**，**亦可單獨測試與替換**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 評測有真實數據集，**並**記錄了一次真實事故****——**逐字**「**backed by a real Langfuse Dataset — not a hardcoded fixture**」**；**並逐字寫道**開發期**「**A real failure was caught and fixed this way during development (a seed-data gap that let a claim route incorrectly)**」**；**⭐ 即**把**「**評測抓到過什麼**」**寫進文檔**，**比**寫**「**我們很重視評測**」**有用得多**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 全鏈路可觀測的工具選擇****——**技術棧逐字為**Python 3.12（`uv`）、**CrewAI（順序流程）**、**FastAPI、**SQLite**；**可觀測逐字為**Langfuse Cloud**（**追蹤、**會話每筆理賠一個、**用戶按患者標註、**數據集與評分**，**另有**應用自管的 LLM 裁判**做**持續有據性打分**）**；**README 逐字說明分工**：**SQLite 是應用運營存儲**，**Langfuse 是可觀測與評測的記錄系統**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 跑起來的門檻寫得很低****——**本地 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`** 跑在 **6GB 顯存**，**回退 **OpenRouter 免費層**，**逐字註明**「**No Docker/Podman required**」**；**登入閘門逐字為 **`admin`**／**`admin`****，**且逐字**「**demo-only, not a real auth boundary**」**——**⭐ 即**作者自己標註**它不是安全邊界**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[azure-medical-claims-processing]]、[[insurance-fraud-frozen-demo]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**多代理 + MCP 工具層 + 確定性閘門 + 真實評測數據集**」**這一組合**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **模型提意見、**規則做決定**；**② **工具放協議層**；**③ **評測集要是真的數據集**；**④ **把評測抓到的事故寫進文檔**；**⑤ **演示系統的認證要自己標註**；**⑥ **在 6GB 顯存與免費層上跑通整條鏈**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有部署、**沒有運行**該系統**，**不主張**其裁決邏輯**的正確性**與**評測結果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料、**README 文本**、**倉庫樹**與**文檔站點響應**，**未讀源碼與 PRD.md 內容**。**③ ⚠️ 其自述**「**real, running**」**與**「**not a toy example**」**均為作者表述**，**本詞條**只如實轉述**，**未**獨立驗證**其在真實業務規模下的表現**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**工具返回的病患與保單數據是否模擬**（**README 逐字提到 **`mcp_server.py`** 內含 **mock data**，**本條據此理解並標註來源為自述**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其與任何健康險公司的關係**；**⚠️ 本條**只按倉庫自述記錄**，**未主張**其為任何基金會的正式項目**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該系統是工程演示**，**不是**理賠決定**，**也**不是**合規意見**。

e.body_en:
This is a health-insurance claims-adjudication demonstration built from three sequential agents, describing itself in writing as a real, running claims-adjudication system and explicitly as not a toy example. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the language-model agents are closed by a deterministic gate.** The described workflow runs policy verification, medical history lookup, and fraud-and-exception scoring, and then a decision gate explicitly labelled deterministic. **In a process with monetary consequences the question of who decides has to be answerable afterwards, and if the decision comes from a rule while the model supplies inputs and reasons, every denial or payment can be explained line by line, which is the first division of labour required to put model assistance inside a regulated process.**

**Second, the tool layer is reached through a protocol server rather than by direct calls.** The description names a local protocol server over standard input and output exposing coverage checking, medical history lookup, and fraud scoring, and states verbatim that agents call tools through the orchestration framework adapter rather than by direct function calls. **Decoupling tools from the orchestration framework means the same tool layer can be carried to another framework and can be tested and replaced on its own.**

**Third, the evaluation has a real dataset behind it and the project records a real incident.** The description states that the dashboard shows decision-routing pass or fail per seeded claim backed by a real observability dataset rather than a hardcoded fixture, and records that a genuine failure was caught and fixed this way during development, namely a seed-data gap that let a claim route incorrectly, with the story kept in a presentation script file. **Writing down what the evaluation actually caught is far more useful to a reader than asserting that evaluation is taken seriously.**

**Fourth, the observability stack is chosen deliberately.** The stated stack is a recent Python runtime managed by a fast package runner, a sequential multi-agent framework, a modern web framework, and a local SQLite store, with tracing, sessions one per claim, users tagged by patient, and datasets with runs and scores held in a hosted observability platform, plus an application-managed language-model judge for continuous groundedness scoring. **The description also separates the roles: the local database is the application own operational store, while the observability platform is the system of record for tracing and evaluation, and every view-trace link in the interface points back to it.**

**Fifth, the entry cost is stated to be low.** A local seven-billion-parameter model runs on a six-gigabyte card as the primary, with a free hosted tier as fallback, and the description states that no container runtime is required. **The login gate is documented as a fixed demonstration pair of credentials and described in writing as being for demonstration only rather than as a real authentication boundary, which is exactly the self-labelling a student demonstration system ought to carry.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover deterministic claims-side integrity review, a cloud vendor medical claims reference, and a vehicle fraud demonstration space, **while this entry supplies the combination of multiple agents, a protocol-level tool layer, a deterministic decision gate, and a real evaluation dataset, and treats local small-model feasibility as a premise rather than a claim. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: let the model propose and the rule decide; put tools at a protocol layer instead of inside the framework; make the evaluation set a real dataset rather than samples hardcoded in the source; write down the incidents evaluation caught; label a demonstration login as not being a security boundary; and treat running the whole chain on a small local model and a free tier as the reproducibility floor.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was neither deployed nor run**, no command was executed, no front or back end was started, and no model or observability service was called, **so no claim is made about the correctness of its adjudication logic or about its evaluation results**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description text, the repository tree, and the documentation site response were read**, not the source or the product requirements document. **Third, the claims that it is real and running and not a toy example are the author own words and are transcribed without independent verification at realistic business scale.** **Fourth, whether the patient and policy data returned by the tools is synthetic was not verified independently**, the description naming mock data inside the protocol server module, which is recorded here as a claim taken from the description. **Fifth, no relationship to any health insurer was verified**, and although the project name contains a foundation acronym, this entry records only what the repository says and does not claim it to be an official foundation project. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the system is an engineering demonstration rather than a claims decision or a compliance opinion.**
